name: Narrow Shoulders
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Break the cracked wall to get the shoulder pads. Put on the thermal underwear.
Inflate the shoulder balloons with the pump.
Wrap the bicycle tire around his neck.
Pour hot water on his hair to flatten it.
Place the clothes hanger across his shoulders.
Put the safety helmet under the outfit.
Wear the suit jacket and place a hanger inside the sleeve.
